label: State Secret
titel: The Aircraft Carrier Made Of Ice

szenen.text: Britain planned an aircraft carrier made of *ice.*
The material was *pykrete:* ice mixed with wood pulp.
The idea came from inventor *Geoffrey Pyke.*
A *small prototype* was built on a Canadian lake in 1943.
Costs rose. The project was *shelved* in 1943.
Genius or madness? Would you have funded it?
